providers.label: My existing direct Responses child
providers.notes: Define the provider in an existing named-agent TOML, then run a local V1 child smoke test before enabling this route.

providers.label: My existing dedicated Responses adapter child
providers.notes: Use one immutable provider and endpoint per adapter. A shared mutable proxy is not a deterministic concurrent route.
